body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Edifier presented 'MP300Plus', its 2.1 portable audio system for notebook, PC, MP3 and all digital media and telephone systems at CES 2010.
It features bass ported, brush-finished aluminum 9W subwoofer for extended bass response and unique designed and magnetically-shielded full-range spherical satellites with metal weave speaker grill.
It's simple to use satellite mounted controls operate on/off and volume up/down functions.
